bagPolicy.summary: Approved bags are clear plastic up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, or clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Paid basketball parking is available through Gates 2, 4, 12, 13, and 14. Accessible drop-off is available at the north and south lobbies, with designated accessible parking nearby.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use Bart Kaufman Field off Fee Lane for Uber, Lyft, and taxi pickup and drop-off.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue provides parking and accessibility accommodations through event staff; guests may contact the Indiana Athletics Ticket Office before arrival for assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: For IU games, you may not leave and re-enter Simon Skjodt Assembly Hall before or during the game. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.summary: For IU Athletics events, bring a photo ID to pick up tickets at Will Call; some orders must be picked up there with the purchasing credit card and a matching photo ID. Electronic tickets are free in the Indiana Hoosiers app, and you can get duplicates at the box office on game day with valid ID.

gates.summary: All public entry points use walk-through metal detectors. Accessible drop-off is available at the north and south lobby entrances.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
